test_cases.title: Both FAIL with different observed values rejects the recording
preconditions: a candidate recording
a tester result line with verdict FAIL, judged_by code, for expected[0] whose observed value differs from what the replay reads
the test server makes the check fail

The mismatch list quotes the replay's observed value for expected[0]

test_cases.title: Both FAIL with the same observed value accepts the recording
preconditions: a candidate recording

the test server makes the check fail

steps.goal: Run tc-replay.js run with --verify for that run_id

expected.text: replay-accepted.json shows status accepted for the TC

test_cases.title: A failing verify replay that blocked an off-site request rejects the recording

the test server makes the check fail

The mismatch list names the blocked origin

test_cases.title: A failing round replay that blocked an off-site request falls back to a tester

tc-results.jsonl has no line for that run_id

test_cases.title: A passing round replay that blocked an off-site request is still recorded
preconditions: an accepted recording
the test page requests an origin that is not base_url and not in browser_origins
the test server makes the check pass

test_cases.title: A button with no effect fails on a page that changes on its own

The fail reason of that button says the page changes on its own

test_cases.title: A working button is not a failure on a page that changes on its own
preconditions: a test page whose clock text changes every 100 ms
a button on that page that changes its own text

steps.goal: Run tc-sweep.js on that page

expected.text: The sweep file does not list that button under fail

test_cases.title: A button that only scrolls the page is not a failure

expected.text: The sweep file does not list that button under fail

test_cases.title: A dialog that opens on load is dismissed and the controls behind it are clicked

test_cases.title: A button that opens a file picker is not a failure

test_cases.title: An already-pressed control with no effect is skipped, not failed
